seoul.frame 오후의 서울, 천천히 걷기

sections.①:
• 브랜드명: Instagram (Meta)
  • 한 줄 정체성: 사진과 짧은 영상으로 일상을 공유하는 글로벌 SNS
  • 공식 디자인 철학: "Capture and share the world's moments — visual-first, simple, vibrant"
  • 시그니처 요소 1개: 5색 그라데이션 카메라 로고(Yellow→Orange→Pink→Purple→Blue) + 둥근 라운드 사각형의 마스코트
sections.②:
• 핵심 키워드 3개: 시각적, 활기참, 일상
  • 무드 설명: 밝거나 검은 중성 캔버스 위에 사진과 영상이 선명하게 떠오른다. UI chrome은 한 발 물러나고 콘텐츠가 모든 것의 중심이 된다.
  • 비주얼 스타일: 모던 미니멀 + 휴머니즘
  • 밀도(Density): Comfortable
  • 모서리 성향: Round (8~16px) — 단, 사진 자체는 sharp 0px
  • 평면성: Subtle
sections.③:
:root {
  /* Primary - Instagram Pink */
  --color-primary-50:  #FCE4F0;
  --color-primary-100: #F8B8D7;
  --color-primary-200: #F18FB7;
  --color-primary-300: #EB5995;
  --color-primary-400: #E63A85;
  --color-primary-500: #E1306C;  /* Instagram Pink */
  --color-primary-600: #C13584;
  --color-primary-700: #833AB4;
  --color-primary-800: #5B2C8A;
  --color-primary-900: #2E1657;

  /* 시그니처 5색 그라데이션 */
  --ig-yellow: #FED373;
  --ig-orange: #F15245;
  --ig-pink:   #D92E7F;
  --ig-purple: #9B36B7;
  --ig-blue:   #515ECF;

  /* Secondary - Instagram Blue (action) */
  --color-secondary-500: #0095F6;

  /* Neutral */
  --color-neutral-0:    #FFFFFF;
  --color-neutral-50:   #FAFAFA;
  --color-neutral-100:  #EFEFEF;
  --color-neutral-200:  #DBDBDB;
  --color-neutral-300:  #C7C7C7;
  --color-neutral-500:  #A8A8A8;
  --color-neutral-700:  #737373;
  --color-neutral-800:  #424242;
  --color-neutral-900:  #262626;
  --color-neutral-1000: #000000;

  /* Semantic */
  --color-success-bg: #DCF7E5;
  --color-success-fg: #00A651;
  --color-warning-bg: #FFF1D9;
  --color-warning-fg: #F5A623;
  --color-error-bg:   #FCE4E4;
  --color-error-fg:   #ED4956;
  --color-info-bg:    #E0F0FE;
  --color-info-fg:    #0095F6;

  /* Surface */
  --bg-base:     #FFFFFF;
  --bg-subtle:   #FAFAFA;
  --bg-elevated: #FFFFFF;
  --bg-overlay:  rgba(0,0,0,0.65);

  /* Text */
  --text-primary:    #262626;
  --text-secondary:  #737373;
  --text-tertiary:   #A8A8A8;
  --text-on-primary: #FFFFFF;
  --text-disabled:   #C7C7C7;

  /* Border */
  --border-default: #DBDBDB;
  --border-subtle:  #EFEFEF;
  --border-strong:  #A8A8A8;
  --border-focus:   #0095F6;
}

[data-theme="dark"] {
  --bg-base: #000000;
  --bg-subtle: #121212;
  --bg-elevated: #1A1A1A;
  --text-primary: #FAFAFA;
  --text-secondary: #A8A8A8;
  --border-default: #262626;
}
sections.④:
• 폰트 페어링:
    • 영문: Instagram Sans / Inter (OFL 폴백) — 폴백 -apple-system
    • 한글: Pretendard (OFL) / Apple SD Gothic Neo
    • 워드마크: Billabong (legacy script)
  • 위계:
    • Display: 56px / 700 / 1.05 / -0.02em
    • H1: 28px / 700 / 1.2 / -0.01em
    • H2: 20px / 700 / 1.27 / 0
    • H3: 16px / 600 / 1.3 / 0
    • Body Large: 14px / 400 / 1.5 / 0
    • Body: 14px / 400 / 1.43 / 0
    • Body Small: 12px / 400 / 1.33 / 0
    • Caption: 11px / 600 / 1.27 / 0
sections.⑦:
--shadow-none: none;
--shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
--shadow-md: 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.10);
--shadow-lg: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.16);
--shadow-xl: 0 16px 32px rgba(225,48,108,0.20);
sections.⑧:
• 스타일: Outline + Filled (heart는 둘 다)
  • Stroke 굵기: 2px
  • 모서리 처리: Round
  • 추천 라이브러리: Lucide / Phosphor
sections.⑨:
Button

.btn {
  font: 600 14px/1 Inter, 'Pretendard', sans-serif;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 0 16px;
  height: 32px;
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
  border: 0;
  transition: background 100ms ease;
}
.btn-primary { background: var(--color-secondary-500); color: #fff; }     /* Instagram Blue 액션 */
.btn-primary:hover { background: #1F8AE0; }
.btn-primary:active { background: #1976C2; }
.btn-follow { background: var(--color-secondary-500); color: #fff; }
.btn-follow.following { background: var(--bg-subtle); color: var(--text-primary); border: 1px solid var(--border-default); }
.btn-secondary { background: var(--bg-subtle); color: var(--text-primary); }
.btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--text-primary); }
.btn-danger { background: var(--color-error-fg); color: #fff; }

Input

.input { background: var(--bg-subtle); border: 1px solid var(--border-default); border-radius: var(--radius-md); padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 14px; }
.input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--border-strong); }

Card (Post)

.post { background: var(--bg-base); border: 1px solid var(--border-default); border-radius: var(--radius-md); margin-bottom: 16px; }
.post .header { padding: 12px 16px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
.post .image { aspect-ratio: 1; background: var(--bg-subtle); border-radius: 0; }
.post .actions { padding: 8px 16px; display: flex; gap: 16px; font-size: 22px; }
.post .actions .save { margin-left: auto; }
.card { background: var(--bg-base); border: 1px solid var(--border-default); border-radius: var(--radius-md); padding: 16px; }
.card-elevated { box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); border-color: transparent; }
.card-outlined { box-shadow: none; }

Story ring (시그니처 그라데이션)

.story-ring { width: 64px; height: 64px; border-radius: 50%; background: linear-gradient(45deg, var(--ig-yellow), var(--ig-orange), var(--ig-pink), var(--ig-purple), var(--ig-blue)); padding: 2.5px; }
.story-ring .inner { background: var(--bg-base); border-radius: 50%; padding: 2px; height: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; }
.story-ring .inner img { border-radius: 50%; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }
.story-ring.viewed { background: var(--border-default); }

Badge

.tag { padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 18px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }
.tag-solid   { background: var(--color-primary-500); color: #fff; }
.tag-subtle  { background: var(--color-primary-50); color: var(--color-primary-700); }
.tag-outline { border: 1px solid var(--border-default); color: var(--text-primary); }
.like-count { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; }

Navigation

.topnav { padding: 12px 16px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; background: var(--bg-base); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-default); }
.topnav .brand { font-family: Georgia, serif; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
sections.⑩:
--duration-fast: 100ms;
--duration-base: 200ms;
--duration-slow: 350ms;
--ease-out: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
--ease-in-out: cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1);
/* 좋아요 더블탭 하트 pop */
--ease-pop: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
sections.⑪: 1. story ring 5색 그라데이션 순서를 임의 변경 금지 2. 사진 라운드를 12px+ 변경 금지 — sharp 0px이 시그니처 3. 좋아요 하트 색을 brand pink로 변경 금지 — Red(#ED4956) 보존 4. Instagram Blue를 brand action 외 분산 사용 금지 5. 본문에 채도 높은 brand 그라데이션 배경 사용 금지 — 이미지가 주인공
sections.⑫:
<style>
  .ig-demo, .ig-demo * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  .ig-demo {
    max-width: 900px; margin: 0 auto; overflow: hidden;
    font-family: Inter, 'Pretendard', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
    color: var(--text-primary); background: var(--bg-base);
    border: 1px solid var(--border-default); border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  }
  .ig-demo svg { display: block; }
  .ig-nav {
    height: 64px; padding: 0 var(--space-xl); display: flex; align-items: center;
    gap: var(--space-xl); background: var(--bg-base); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  }
  .ig-wordmark {
    font-family: 'Brush Script MT', 'Segoe Script', cursive; font-size: 28px;
    line-height: 1; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -1.5px;
  }
  .ig-search {
    width: 240px; height: 36px; margin-left: auto; padding: 0 14px;
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: var(--text-secondary);
    background: var(--bg-subtle); border-radius: var(--radius-md); font-size: 14px;
  }
  .ig-nav-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 18px; }
  .profile-hero {
    max-width: 760px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 44px 28px 34px;
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: 168px minmax(0,1fr); gap: 54px; align-items: center;
  }
  .profile-ring {
    width: 156px; height: 156px; padding: 4px; border-radius: var(--radius-full);
    background: linear-gradient(45deg,var(--ig-yellow),var(--ig-orange),var(--ig-pink),var(--ig-purple),var(--ig-blue));
  }
  .profile-avatar {
    position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden;
    border: 5px solid var(--bg-base); border-radius: var(--radius-full);
    background: linear-gradient(155deg,#B9DBE8 0 48%,#F2CA85 49% 62%,#385D50 63%);
  }
  .profile-avatar::before {
    content: ''; position: absolute; left: 22px; right: 16px; bottom: 24px; height: 55px;
    background: #25433C; clip-path: polygon(0 82%,25% 42%,43% 64%,68% 12%,100% 78%,100% 100%,0 100%);
  }
  .profile-avatar::after {
    content: ''; position: absolute; right: 28px; top: 24px; width: 30px; height: 30px;
    border-radius: 50%; background: #FFE7A3; box-shadow: 0 0 22px rgba(255,231,163,.7);
  }
  .profile-title { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .profile-title h1 { margin: 0 4px 0 0; font-size: 20px; line-height: 32px; font-weight: 400; }
  .verified { width: 16px; height: 16px; color: var(--color-secondary-500); }
  .profile-title .btn { cursor: default; }
  .profile-stats { display: flex; gap: 34px; margin: 22px 0; font-size: 15px; }
  .profile-stats strong { font-weight: 700; }
  .profile-bio { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; }
  .profile-bio strong { display: block; }
  .profile-bio span { color: var(--text-secondary); }
  .profile-link { color: #00376B; font-weight: 700; }
  .profile-tabs {
    height: 53px; display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 52px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--border-default); color: var(--text-secondary);
  }
  .profile-tab {
    height: 53px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px;
    border-top: 1px solid transparent; margin-top: -1px;
    font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .08em;
  }
  .profile-tab.active { color: var(--text-primary); border-top-color: var(--text-primary); }
  .post-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,1fr); gap: 4px; background: var(--bg-base); }
  .feature-card {
    position: relative; aspect-ratio: 1; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 0;
    isolation: isolate; background: var(--bg-subtle);
  }
  .feature-card::after {
    content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 4; opacity: 0;
    background: rgba(0,0,0,.34); transition: opacity var(--duration-base) var(--ease-out);
  }
  .feature-card:hover::after, .feature-card:hover .post-meta { opacity: 1; }
  .post-meta {
    position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 5; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    gap: 22px; color: #fff; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity var(--duration-base) var(--ease-out);
  }
  .post-meta span { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
  .post-sunset { background: linear-gradient(180deg,#A7D5E5 0 48%,#F3C77D 49% 61%,#31564B 62%); }
  .post-sunset .sun { position: absolute; right: 16%; top: 16%; width: 17%; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 50%; background: #FFE7A3; box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(255,231,163,.8); }
  .post-sunset .roof { position: absolute; left: -8%; right: -8%; bottom: 17%; height: 37%; background: #253D38; clip-path: polygon(0 100%,0 72%,27% 31%,42% 61%,67% 5%,100% 66%,100% 100%); }
  .post-sunset .rail { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 22%; border-top: 5px solid #C89F6A; background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#724B36 0 30px,#835B42 31px 58px); }
  .post-studio { background: linear-gradient(115deg,#EEE2D0 0 57%,#C88458 58%); }
  .post-studio .window { position: absolute; left: 12%; top: 11%; width: 43%; height: 53%; border: 8px solid #F9F4EA; background: linear-gradient(#8DC4D9 0 54%,#6C8A64 55%); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }
  .post-studio .table { position: absolute; left: 18%; right: 8%; bottom: 11%; height: 21%; transform: skewX(-8deg); background: #84553C; box-shadow: 0 14px 0 #5A382B; }
  .post-studio .vase { position: absolute; right: 22%; bottom: 30%; width: 16%; height: 24%; border-radius: 45% 45% 28% 28%; background: #F6C26B; }
  .post-studio .vase::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 38%; bottom: 74%; width: 55%; height: 85%; border-radius: 70% 0 70% 0; background: #55765B; transform: rotate(-26deg); }
  .post-coast { background: linear-gradient(180deg,#84C5DE 0 43%,#2B86A6 44% 67%,#E8C98E 68%); }
  .post-coast .sunshade { position: absolute; left: 14%; bottom: 21%; width: 48%; height: 28%; border-radius: 100% 100% 8% 8%; background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#F8EEE0 0 23px,#E85A4F 24px 46px); transform: rotate(-7deg); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); }
  .post-coast .sunshade::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 90%; width: 4px; height: 86%; background: #6E523D; transform: rotate(7deg); transform-origin: top; }
  .post-coast .towel { position: absolute; right: 9%; bottom: 8%; width: 34%; height: 12%; background: #F5E3BD; transform: skewX(-18deg) rotate(4deg); }
  @media (max-width: 620px) {
    .ig-nav { padding: 0 16px; }
    .ig-search { display: none; }
    .ig-nav-actions { margin-left: auto; }
    .profile-hero { grid-template-columns: 88px 1fr; gap: 20px; padding: 28px 18px; }
    .profile-ring { width: 88px; height: 88px; padding: 3px; }
    .profile-avatar { border-width: 3px; }
    .profile-stats { gap: 14px; margin: 14px 0; font-size: 12px; }
    .profile-bio { font-size: 12px; }
    .profile-title .btn-secondary { display: none; }
    .profile-tabs { gap: 32px; }
  }
</style>
